narr: Heavy rain producing thunderstorms moved across Banner and Scotts Bluff Counties producing over an inch of rainfall contributing to street flooding in the city of Scottsbluff and out in the country of Banner County.
ev: Roads near Pumpkin Creek east of Highway 71 were reported flooded.
